description.zh:
指定要查询的集群的ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the cluster that you want to query.
> You can call the [DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh:
目标开关的配置的操作维度。取值：
- **Cluster**：集群ID
description.en:
The operation dimension of the target switch configuration. Valid values:
- **Cluster**: cluster ID.

description.zh:
配置类型。取值：
- **containerNetwork**：容器网络拓扑开关
- **interceptionSwitch**：集群微隔离开关
description.en:
The configuration type. Valid values:
- **containerNetwork**: container network topology switch
- **interceptionSwitch**: cluster microsegmentation switch.

title.zh: 根据集群编号查询集群信息
title.en: Query cluster information by cluster ID

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-cluster-basic-info --cluster-id c870ec78ecbcb41d2a35c679823ef0000 --type containerNetwork --target-type Cluster --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas DescribeClusterBasicInfo --region cn-hangzhou --Type containerNetwork --ClusterId c870ec78ecbcb41d2a35c679823ef0000 --TargetType Cluster
